subtasks.description: Declare the 4-bit rcnt register, 32-bit out register, and optional combinational wires next_rcnt (4-bit) and next_out (32-bit) for connecting B2 and B3.
constraints: rcnt must be declared as reg [3:0]
out must be declared as reg [31:0] matching the output port width

subtasks.description: Combinational logic to compute next_rcnt (counter increment/reset) and next_out (round constant or zero) based on kld and rcnt. Must implement the GF(2^8) multiplication sequence or equivalent lookup table to produce RC values in the MSByte.
Sequential always block that on posedge clk assigns next_rcnt to rcnt and next_out to out, implementing synchronous register update with load/reset via kld.
constraints: Update rcnt and out on the rising edge of clk only
